title: Formal fibres over the generic point of k[[x]][y] in characteristic p are geometrically regular
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $n,m\ge0$ and $A=k[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]][y_1,\ldots,y_m]$, the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring] in $y_1,\ldots,y_m$ over the formal power series ring $k[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]; it is a Noetherian domain. Let $K=\kappa((0))=A_{(0)}$ be its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], let $\mathfrak p\subset A$ be a prime ideal and $(A_{\mathfrak p})^\wedge=\varprojlim_rA_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak p^rA_{\mathfrak p}$ the completion of $A_{\mathfrak p}$ at its maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then the $K$-algebra $(A_{\mathfrak p})^\wedge\otimes_AK$ is Noetherian and geometrically regular over $K$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].
